# Full Documentation: Apps by Halik Magomedov

Detailed overview of iOS utilities designed for mindfulness, relationships, and finance.

---

## 1. Couple Status - Stay Connected

### Value Proposition
Couple Status is an ambient relationship widget app designed to replace endless logistics texts and communication anxiety with glanceable Lock Screen and Apple Watch indicators. It bridges the emotional distance between partners without demanding constant conversation.

### The 4 Core Pillars
1. **Skip the "Roommate Vibe"**: Daily routines often reduce relationship communication to purely administrative check-ins. Couple Status lets you see if your partner is "Doing Chores", heading home, resting, or needs "Alone Time" without sending a single text. Focus on being romantic partners, not logistics managers.
2. **Bridge the Distance (LDR Presence)**: For long-distance couples or mismatched daily schedules, a quick glance at the lock screen widget shows if your partner is in a "Flirty Mood" or "Thinking of You". It provides constant emotional warmth without battery-draining FaceTime calls or 24/7 texting pressure.
3. **Connect Without "Interruption Guilt"**: Respect each other's focus. Check if your partner is in a "Work Call" or immersed in "Focused Work" before calling or texting. Stay connected without accidentally derailing their cognitive flow.
4. **Low-Pressure & Nonverbal Connection for Autistic and Neurodivergent Couples**: Built for couples navigating Autism, ADHD, or AuDHD:
   - **Nonverbal Status Signaling**: During sensory overload or nonverbal shutdown, partners can signal "Alone Time" or "Decompressing" with a single tap, avoiding uncomfortable verbal explanations.
   - **Rejection Sensitive Dysphoria (RSD) Relief**: Knowing your partner is "Doing Chores" or in "Deep Focus" prevents anxious overthinking when messages aren't immediately answered.
   - **Hyperfocus Protection**: Autistic/ADHD hyperfocus is delicate. Visibility into focus states prevents jarring interruptions.
   - **Zero Demand Avoidance (PDA)**: Lightweight status nudges and haptic "Thinking of You" hugs require zero verbal composition or response obligation.

### Core Features
*   **Lock Screen & Home Screen Widgets**: Instantly see your partner's status and mood at a glance.
*   **Apple Watch Complications**: View partner context on watchOS complications without picking up your phone.
*   **"Thinking of You" Haptic Hugs**: Send a subtle digital vibration with a single tap to let them know you care.
*   **Custom & Preset Moods**: Choose from preset states ("Doing Chores", "Flirty Mood", "Focused Work", "Alone Time", "Decompressing", "Free to Chat") or set custom statuses.
*   **One Shared Subscription**: Pay once, and both partners enjoy full access with a single purchase.

### Comparison Against Other Apps
| Dimension | Couple Status | Locket Widget | Widgetable | Obimy | Paired |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Primary Mechanism** | Ambient status & mood widgets | Live camera photos | Social widgets & pets | Moods & physical touches | Daily quiz questions |
| **Effort / Friction** | Low (glanceable) | High (requires camera) | Medium (social feeds) | Low-Medium | Medium (requires reading/typing) |
| **Cognitive Demand** | Very Low (Nonverbal friendly) | High | Medium | Low | High |
| **Apple Watch Complications** | Yes | No | Limited | No | No |
| **Subscription Model** | One sub covers both partners | Ad-supported / Sub | Individual subs | Individual sub | High recurring sub |

### Technical & Compatibility
*   Requires iOS 26.0 or later.
*   Requires watchOS 26.0 or later.
*   Compatible with iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch.
*   Category: Lifestyle.

## 2. Timecostify: Cost in Time

### Value Proposition
A cognitive reframing tool for personal finance. Instead of evaluating price tags in abstract dollars, Timecostify calculates prices in terms of the hours you must work to earn that amount. It helps users make more mindful, deliberate spending decisions.

### Core Features
*   **Work Hours Converter**: Type any price and see the cost converted into work hours, days, weeks, months, or years based on your custom wage input (hourly, monthly, or yearly).
*   **Interactive Widgets**: Track spending decisions ("Buy" or "Don't Buy") directly from the iOS Home Screen.
*   **Savings Tracker**: Visualize your accumulated savings and tracked decisions in simple, motivating charts.
*   **Multi-Currency Support**: Automatically converts foreign currencies for seamless calculations when traveling or shopping online.
*   **Household Mode**: Supports individual calculations or combined household schedules.

### Technical & Compatibility
*   Requires iOS 18.6 or later.
*   Compatible with iPhone, iPad, and iPod touch.
*   Category: Finance.

### URLs
*   Landing Page: https://pand0raq.dev/timecostify/
*   Search Intent Guide: https://pand0raq.dev/price-in-work-hours-calculator/
*   Privacy Policy: https://pand0raq.dev/timecostifyprivacypolicy/

## 3. Breathe Pulse - Haptic Breathing

### Value Proposition
Mindfulness and breathwork tool utilizing the Taptic Engine on iPhone and Apple Watch to guide breathing exercises without needing to look at the screen.
*   App Store: [Breathe Pulse](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/breathe-pulse-haptic-breathing/id6503657317)
*   Privacy Policy: https://pand0raq.dev/breathpulseprivacypolicy/

## 4. PottyDog - Pet Activity Tracker

### Value Proposition
A companion app for dog owners to track walks, food, potty timings, and general health metrics.
*   App Store: [PottyDog](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/pottydog-dog-poop-tracker/id6739466542)
*   Privacy Policy: https://pand0raq.dev/pottydogprivacypolicy/
